subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 3 updates

question: Should this routine GitHub Actions pin update require posted redacted after-fix workflow evidence before merge, or should the successful CI checks be accepted as sufficient operational evidence?
rationale: The patch has no discrete source defect, but the external-PR proof policy makes the remaining merge gate an operational evidence decision rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require posted workflow proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted run log or artifact shows the updated action revisions executing successfully.

options.title: Accept existing check evidence
options.body: Merge based on the successful supplied checks while explicitly accepting the lack of a separately posted real-behavior artifact.

recommendation.title: Require posted workflow proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted run log or artifact shows the updated action revisions executing successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline places steipete in the initial review routing, though source-history ownership could not be established from the supplied evidence.
